subject: South Asian Pali editorial and printing labor
documented_finding: Entry 1495 names Dharmārāma Sthavira and the Pāliyagoda printers D. L. Rūpāsiṃha and M. I. Perera in connection with a Pali commentary installment.
evidence_limit: Does not establish that Lovejoy consulted this edition.

subject: Lovejoy Buddhist technical-term research
documented_finding: Lovejoy analyzes upādāna and upādisesa and cites the Milinda Pañha.
evidence_limit: Does not identify all contemporary readers.

subject: International indexing of Lovejoy Buddhist article
documented_finding: Entry 1492 lists Lovejoy's 1898 Journal of the American Oriental Society article under Pali and Prakrit.
evidence_limit: Indexing establishes discoverability rather than intellectual uptake by a named scholar.

subject: American Oriental Society and Bavarian bibliographic support
documented_finding: Scherman reports spring 1899 subsidies from the Royal Bavarian Academy and the American Oriental Society.
evidence_limit: Institutional support does not show that the Society selected Lovejoy's entry.

subject: Lanman role in transatlantic bibliographic infrastructure
documented_finding: Scherman thanks Charles R. Lanman together with E. Kuhn and A. V. W. Jackson for their initiative.
evidence_limit: Does not establish that Lanman nominated or arranged Lovejoy's inclusion.

subject: Lanman and Lévi in the same contemporary specialist index
documented_finding: Entries 1418 and 1419 consecutively identify works by Lanman and Sylvain Lévi.
evidence_limit: Shared indexing is not proof of interpersonal contact or transmission.

subject: Specht Chinese Milindapañha course
documented_finding: Specht teaches the Chinese recension of the Milindapañha in the EPHE Sanskrit-chair environment.
evidence_limit: The report does not name Lovejoy as an attendee.

subject: La Vallée Poussin as named attendee in Paris Buddhist text instruction
documented_finding: La Vallée Poussin appears by name in Specht's Chinese Milindapañha instruction and Foucher's Sanskrit conference.
evidence_limit: Does not document a personal connection to Lovejoy or reception of Lovejoy's article.

subject: Pandit Ganapati Śāstrī as Sanskrit author and educational producer
documented_finding: The Travancore scholar authors a Sanskrit reader intended for Indian schools and European instruction; printing has begun under Lévi's supervision.
evidence_limit: No direct Lovejoy connection has been established.

subject: Paramārtha and comparative Sanskrit-Chinese Indian philosophy
documented_finding: Lévi compares a Chinese translation attributed to Paramārtha with the Sanskrit Sāṃkhya-kārikā.
evidence_limit: Postdates Lovejoy's Paris residence and does not establish his attendance.

subject: Documented Pali competence and Kashgar Dhammapada in Paris
documented_finding: Cuny is described as having learned Sanskrit and Pali and intending to study the Kashgar Dhammapada.
evidence_limit: Does not prove a formally advertised 1898–99 Pali course or Lovejoy participation.

subject: Specht Chinese Buddhist doctrinal teaching
documented_finding: Specht uses a Chinese Buddhist Amṛtaśāstra and teaches rebirth, action, aggregates, conditioned formations, and causal links.
evidence_limit: Shared concepts with Lovejoy establish subject-matter overlap only.

subject: Chinese Buddhist canon instruction in Paris
documented_finding: Specht's additional conference reads works from the Chinese Buddhist canon.
evidence_limit: The institutional report does not document Lovejoy's attendance or use.

subject: Exact-year Paris Chinese Buddhist course announcement
documented_finding: The official 1898–99 EPHE programme schedules Specht's Fo-tsou-tong-ki course on the history of Buddhism in China for Mondays at 3:15 p.m.
evidence_limit: A scheduled course does not establish Lovejoy's attendance or knowledge of Chinese.

subject: Exact-year Paris Chinese Buddhist course actually delivered
documented_finding: The Sanskrit-chair report confirms that Specht continued a weekly Sanskrit–Chinese conference and explained Fo-tsou-tong-ki chapters on Buddhist history during 1898–99.
evidence_limit: No attendance list connecting Lovejoy to the conference has been recovered.

subject: Asaṅga-related Nepal Buddhist manuscript
documented_finding: A contemporary Académie notice identifies an Asaṅga-attributed Sūtrālaṃkāra manuscript acquired during Lévi's Nepal research.
evidence_limit: This manuscript is not identical to Huber's Aśvaghoṣa-related project.

subject: Distinct Aśvaghoṣa-related Buddhist translation project
documented_finding: The 1903 EPHE report identifies Huber's completed Sūtrālaṃkāra translation; Lévi's letter of 1 October 1903 independently identifies its author attribution as Aśvaghoṣa.
evidence_limit: The similar title must not be conflated with the distinct Asaṅga-related Nepal manuscript.

subject: Lovejoy American Oriental Society membership extended to December 1900
documented_finding: A corporate-member list expressly revised December 1900 retains Arthur Oncken Lovejoy and gives his year of election as 1897.
evidence_limit: The roll's 1900 revision does not prove continued membership when its containing index was issued in April 1902.

subject: American Oriental Society record of Lovejoy Paris correspondence address
documented_finding: The December 1900 member roll records Lovejoy's institutional correspondence address as 5 Rue Rollin in Paris.
evidence_limit: The address may be administratively stale and does not establish physical residence in Paris during 1900 or 1902.

subject: Upper bound on Lovejoy American Oriental Society membership
documented_finding: The roll revised January 1903 passes from Jacob W. Loch to Percival Lowell without listing Lovejoy.
evidence_limit: His exact departure date and reason remain unproved; the corrected exit interval runs after December 1901 and before January 1903.

subject: Lovejoy American Oriental Society membership extended to December 1901
documented_finding: A corporate-member list expressly revised December 1901 retains Arthur Oncken Lovejoy and again gives his 1897 election year.
evidence_limit: The 1901 volume label must not be mistaken for a separately established physical issue date.

subject: American Oriental Society reports no current Lovejoy mailing address
documented_finding: The December 1901 roster replaces Lovejoy's prior Paris address with the explicit notation [address desired.].
evidence_limit: The notation establishes missing correspondence information but does not establish resignation or nonpayment.

subject: Albert J Edmunds and Lovejoy share American Oriental Society membership
documented_finding: The same AOS member roll identifies Albert J. Edmunds at the Historical Society of Pennsylvania and Arthur Oncken Lovejoy under his Harvard affiliation.
evidence_limit: Shared membership does not establish a meeting or correspondence.

subject: Named Pali Text Society specialist selects Lovejoy article
documented_finding: On page 44 Albert J. Edmunds explicitly lists Lovejoy's 1898 Buddhist technical-term article in his signed Buddhist bibliography.
evidence_limit: Signed bibliographic selection does not establish argumentative citation or full-text agreement.

subject: Contemporary classification of Lovejoy alongside Lévi and Jacobi
documented_finding: Edmunds places Lovejoy in Comparative Religion Psychology and special criticism immediately after Sylvain Lévi and near Jacobi's Buddhism–Sāṃkhya–nidāna study.
evidence_limit: Published classificatory proximity does not establish interpersonal influence.

subject: Earlier Specht and Lévi collaboration on Chinese Milindapañha versions
documented_finding: Edmunds page 27 identifies Specht's two Chinese Milindapañha translations with an introduction by Sylvain Lévi and associates the work with the 1892 Orientalist congress.
evidence_limit: The original congress proceedings have not yet been directly inspected; Lovejoy's use remains unproved.
